CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tags_are_normalized(tags text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT COALESCE(cardinality(tags) <= 30, FALSE)
       AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM unnest(tags) AS t(tag)
             WHERE t.tag IS NULL
                OR t.tag = ''
                OR t.tag <> lower(btrim(t.tag))
                OR char_length(t.tag) > 50)
$function$
